flagRules: Preconditions name it (e.g. voice_price_assistant_enabled) and say whether it is on or off on test.gokesari.com today

3. Ask for it to be switched on

P0 first: money, access, state changes; then P1 and P2; phone layout where there is a screen
Write 'flag on' or 'flag off' in Build / release on every result row, with the evidence ID
Ask for the flag to be put back as it was; note it in the Execution Log
